title: On Sneezing twice in the cold hall
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：sneeze　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sneeze 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the craftsman ① sneezed twice in the cold hall before dawn, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② sneezes twice in the cold hall in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sneeze twice in the cold hall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sneezed twice in the cold hall before — a line in the ledger for August 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sneezing twice in the cold hall before dawn, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sneeze through the whole of March in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sneeze through the whole of March at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ sneezes through the whole of March before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sneezed twice in the cold hall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sneeze twice in the cold hall, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody sneezes twice in the cold hall in public again and somebody must sneeze twice in the cold hall before dawn all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 打喷嚏（一般现在 sneezes twice in the cold hall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打喷嚏（不定式 to sneeze twice in the cold hall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打喷嚏（过去完成时 had sneezed twice in the cold hall：1960 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打喷嚏（动名词 sneezing twice in the cold hall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 一连串地打喷嚏（sneeze through the whole of March：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去一连串地打喷嚏整个三月喷嚏打个不停）
G. v. 一连串地打喷嚏（sneeze through the whole of March：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打喷嚏（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 sneezes through the whole of March，而母亲又一次 sneezed twice in the cold hall）

sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，自那以后匠人当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sneezes。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打喷嚏在冰冷的大厅里打了两个喷嚏”，此处为不定式 to sneeze twice in the cold hall。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人打喷嚏过，故用过去完成时 had sneezed。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，匠人说“打喷嚏在冰冷的大厅里打了两个喷嚏这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sneezing twice in the cold hall 作主语。
sneeze 意为“一连串地打喷嚏”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去一连串地打喷嚏整个三月喷嚏打个不停”，should ever 之后用原形 sneeze through the whole of March。
sneeze 意为“一连串地打喷嚏”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻一连串地打喷嚏整个三月喷嚏打个不停（sneeze through the whole of March at once），以后再也不要提起。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例一连串地打喷嚏整个三月喷嚏打个不停，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sneezes。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就打喷嚏在冰冷的大厅里打了两个喷嚏，用一般过去式 sneezed 叙述。
sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要打喷嚏在冰冷的大厅里打了两个喷嚏，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

answers: In 1966 the craftsman sneezed twice in the cold hall before dawn, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the craftsman still sneezes twice in the cold hall in public without being asked.
My mother said later that to sneeze twice in the cold hall at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had sneezed twice in the cold hall long before 1973, and the line in the ledger for August proves it.
Sneezing twice in the cold hall before dawn, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Sneeze through the whole of March at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sneeze 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the craftsman sneezed twice in the cold hall before dawn, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman sneezes twice in the cold hall in public whenever the workshop asks.
Sneezing twice in the cold hall before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sneeze through the whole of March in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop sneezes through the whole of March before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sneezed twice in the cold hall again, and the workshop remembered that half.
